mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_approval_form WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY form_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_approval_doc (doc_no, form_id, title, content_json, drafter_id, status_cd) VALUES (#{docNo}, #{formId}, #{title}, #{contentJson}, #{drafterId}, COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'DRAFT'))
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_approval_doc SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_approval_line (doc_id, step_no, approver_id, line_type_cd, status_cd) VALUES (#{docId}, #{stepNo}, #{approverId}, COALESCE(#{lineTypeCd}, 'APPROVE'), COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'PENDING'))
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, f.form_cd, f.form_nm, u.name AS drafter_name, dept.dept_nm AS drafter_dept FROM gw_approval_doc d JOIN gw_approval_form f ON f.form_id = d.form_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = d.drafter_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE d.doc_id = #{docId}
SELECT l.*, u.name AS approver_name FROM gw_approval_line l JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = l.approver_id WHERE l.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY l.step_no

SELECT DISTINCT d.*, f.form_cd, f.form_nm, u.name AS drafter_name, dept.dept_nm AS drafter_dept FROM gw_approval_doc d JOIN gw_approval_form f ON f.form_id = d.form_id JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = d.drafter_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = u.dept_id JOIN gw_approval_line l ON l.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE l.approver_id = #{approverId} AND l.status_cd = 'PENDING' AND d.status_cd = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND l.step_no = ( SELECT MIN(l2.step_no) FROM gw_approval_line l2 WHERE l2.doc_id = d.doc_id AND l2.status_cd = 'PENDING' ) ORDER BY d.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 200
